question_text:
Using data in Table, calculate the self-diffusivity for iron in bec iron at $900^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Give your answer as the value of self_diffusivity. 
(Referrence to Table: 
\begin{tabular}{llrcc}
\hline \multicolumn{5}{c}{ Diffusivity Data for a Number of Metallic Systems ${ }^{\text {a }}$} \\
\hline Solute & Solvent & $\boldsymbol{D}_{\mathbf{0}}\left(\mathbf{m}^{\mathbf{2}} / \mathbf{s}\right)$ & $\boldsymbol{Q ( k J} / \mathbf{m o l})$ & $\boldsymbol{Q ( k c a l} / \mathbf{m o l})$ \\
\hline Carbon & Fcc iron & $20 \times 10^{-6}$ & 142 & 34.0 \\
Carbon & Bcc iron & $220 \times 10^{-6}$ & 122 & 29.3 \\
Iron & Fcc iron & $22 \times 10^{-6}$ & 268 & 64.0 \\
Iron & Bcc iron & $200 \times 10^{-6}$ & 240 & 57.5 \\
Nickel & Fcc iron & $77 \times 10^{-6}$ & 280 & 67.0 \\
Manganese & Fcc iron & $35 \times 10^{-6}$ & 282 & 67.5 \\
Zinc & Copper & $34 \times 10^{-6}$ & 191 & 45.6 \\
Copper & Aluminum & $15 \times 10^{-6}$ & 126 & 30.2 \\
Copper & Copper & $20 \times 10^{-6}$ & 197 & 47.1 \\
Silver & Silver & $40 \times 10^{-6}$ & 184 & 44.1 \\
Carbon & Hcp titanium & $511 \times 10^{-6}$ & 182 & 43.5 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
)The unit of the answer is m^2/s.
response:
Using the Arrhenius equation for self-diffusion:

$$D = D_0 \exp\!\left(-\frac{Q}{RT}\right)$$

From the table for **Iron in Bcc iron**:
- $D_0 = 200 \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2/s}$
- $Q = 240\ \mathrm{kJ/mol} = 240{,}000\ \mathrm{J/mol}$
- $R = 8.314\ \mathrm{J/(mol\cdot K)}$
- $T = 900 + 273 = 1173\ \mathrm{K}$

$$D = (200\times10^{-6})\exp\!\left(-\frac{240000}{8.314 \times 1173}\right) = 4.10 \times 10^{-15}\ \mathrm{m^2/s}$$

$$\boxed{4.10 \times 10^{-15}}$$
